verdict_text:
YES

The script targets exactly the 48 projection matrices via a `fullmatch` regex (so `h.<i>.attn.c_attn.bias` and the like are not caught), casts them with `.to(torch.bfloat16)`, keeps every other tensor as float32 with unchanged values, drops exactly the 12 `h.<i>.attn.bias` buffers (again `fullmatch`, so no parameter is removed), preserves names, and asserts all four required checks before writing. The only thing not verifiable from this file is `save_sharded_safetensors` in `_ckpt`, which is given the 64 MiB limit and must produce the index and single-tensor shard for `wte.weight`.
